messages.author: 62f5a27be944b299
messages.subject: Moving Window
parts:
Hi Chris and everyone!

I am trying to get AKDE home ranges for about 40 elephants with 20 years of 1 hr or 30 min GPS interval tracking data. I am interested in getting annual home ranges (every 365 days) for each elephant using a moving window in a nested for loop. Can you advise on how to create these moving windows. Also, do I need to resample my data to a fix a day or are the 1 hr or 30 min good to go?

Many thanks,
Nelson Mwangi.

messages.author: 40fd627580dd34f5
messages.subject: Re: Moving Window
parts:
Hi Nelson,

You do not need to resample the data in ctmm, which is the benefit of working with continuous-time models. In the past, some forum users have posted their code for doing moving window analyses: e.g., https://groups.google.com/g/ctmm-user/c/e470UCh12yg/m/ltUL8H6lAAAJ
If you search, there are a few more examples. I need to code up a function for this at some point.

Best,
Chris
